summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments from automated reviewers, handle merge conflicts from integrating the phase 25 branch, and keep the planning files and codebase in sync.
summary.outcome: All 4 Copilot review threads were resolved with code fixes, merge conflicts across 4 planning files were resolved preserving both phase 24 and 25 completions, and a follow-up integration test fix was committed and pushed.

repo: cipher-box uses a .planning/ directory with ROADMAP.md, PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, and STATE.md for tracking project state across branches
The project is organized into numbered phases (at least through phase 25); planning files are updated per-phase and can conflict during merges
v2 encoding uses hex-only — base64 fallback was vestigial and has been removed (recovery.html:1104)
SDK integration tests live in packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts and had the same encoding fix needed as the E2E tests

code.finding: Removed base64 fallback — v2 protocol is hex-only
Type widened to string | undefined with non-null assertions at usage sites rather than asserting at declaration
Plan checkboxes and table column alignment were incorrect; Copilot flagged both
Integration test had same encoding issue as E2E tests — needed the same fix applied earlier in the session

workflow: Copilot review threads can be bulk-resolved via GraphQL mutation after replying via REST API
When merging branches where both sides completed independent phases, conflict resolution should preserve all completed-phase markers from both sides
gh api graphql is used for resolving review threads; REST endpoint used for posting replies (in_reply_to must be integer, use --field not -f)

friction: Merge required stashing local changes before merging main — working tree was dirty at merge time
STATE.md required multiple edit passes to fully resolve its 3 conflict markers, including a re-read and verify loop
